_upstream.body_excerpt:
Show a loading indicator while the resume picker starts

## Why

`codex resume` can wait for the app server connection and login status
before the session picker opens, leaving the terminal blank while they wait.

## What changed

Display “Loading sessions…” during startup using the same styling as the
picker. Clear the inline indicator after the login status check or when
startup fails or is canceled.

## Testing

Add a terminal test that holds open a Unix socket to stall the connection,
checks that `codex resume --no-alt-screen` displays the loading indicator,
then closes the socket and verifies that the error replaces the indicator.
